T: Never sick. Never hurt. Always hungry.
D: The sole survivor of a train crash learns from a fragile comic book collector that he may be a real superhero.
P: Serve the mains when David sits down to breakfast with his son Joseph.
S: David's job as a stadium security guard
Soft pretzels boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard.
a Philadelphia breakfast before the stadium shift
Pork and cornmeal loaf sliced and fried until crisp, with apple butter and fried eggs.
Homemade purple sweet potato chips, fried thin and crisp and dusted with salt. Slice 2 purple sweet potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in cold water 20 minutes.
M: David, Audrey and Joseph at the kitchen table
Scrambled eggs, bacon, buttered toast and orange juice served family style at the breakfast table.
David lifting more than he ever knew he could
Rump steak grilled to medium, sliced with roast potatoes and green beans, a big plate for a strong man.
W: Mr Glass and his fragile bones
Lemon juice and sugar warmed with gelatine until dissolved, poured into round glasses over blueberries and raspberries, set for 4 hours until clear.

s.note: David's job as a stadium security guard
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.
Slice 2 purple sweet potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in cold water 20 minutes. Dry well and fry in batches at 170C until crisp. Drain and season with salt flakes.

m.note: David lifting more than he ever knew he could
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Grill 4 rump steaks to medium and rest. Melt butter with crushed garlic and pour over. Steam green beans and toss with more butter. Serve a big plate for anyone lifting heavy.

w.note: Mr Glass and his fragile bones
w.how: Warm 500ml water with the juice of 3 lemons and 120g sugar. Soak 5 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in until dissolved. Divide 125g blueberries and 125g raspberries among round glasses and pour over the jelly. Chill for 4 hours until clear and set.

d.how: Brew 4 green tea bags in a litre of water just off the boil for 3 minutes. Stir in honey to taste and add a slice of lemon to each cup. Serve hot while the rain comes down outside, poncho optional.
